mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate empagliflozin's hypoglycemic effects and increase risk of hyponatremia through SIADH, while empagliflozin increases euglycemic DKA risk which MAOIs may mask through altered sympathetic response.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely, assess for euglycemic DKA symptoms (nausea, dyspnea, abdominal pain despite normal glucose), and monitor sodium levels; consider alternative antidepressant if possible.
